How it works

Three steps to sharper thinking

01

Pick your mode

Choose from twenty-five practice modes — job interviews, public speaking, salary negotiation, sales, angry customers, debate, police training, rap battle and more. Set the scenario, pick Easy, Normal or Hard.

02

Practice by voice or text

Argue out loud with natural voice conversation, or type if you prefer. Your opponent pushes back in real time — cross-examining, probing, and refusing to let sloppy thinking pass.

03

Get a real coaching scorecard

Every session ends with your scores, the exact moments that cost you points quoted from your own words, a better line to say instead, and a five-minute drill for next time.

FAQ

Questions, answered

What is AdversaryAI?

AdversaryAI is an AI sparring partner. You pick a practice mode — debate, job interview, negotiation, and more — then argue your case by voice or by text. The AI pushes back in real time, and when the session ends you get detailed coaching scores on your argument strength, evidence, rebuttals, and composure.

How does a session work?

You choose a mode and a scenario (anything from "AI should be regulated" to a mock interview for a product role), pick your opponent style, and set the difficulty. You choose your match length — a 3-round quick spar, a 6-round bout, a 10-round deep debate, or open freestyle — and tap End & Grade anytime to receive a full AI scorecard.

Do I need a microphone?

No. Voice sessions need a mic, but text sessions work with just a keyboard — same opponents, same scoring. Many people start with text and switch to voice once they're warmed up.

Is there a free trial?

Yes — your first 15 rounds are free in every practice mode, voice or text, no card. The free scorecard shows your score, the dimension bars, your #1 priority and your biggest missed moment; any plan or pack unlocks every missed moment, the better lines and your next drill.

What does it cost after the trial?

Debater is $12/month for 300 rounds, Coach is $29/month for 750 rounds, Champion is $49/month for 500 premium rounds plus 60 minutes of photoreal video opponents and our strongest reasoning model, and Elite is $100/month for 1,000 premium rounds and 2 hours of photoreal video. Prefer one-off? Round packs cost $9 for 100, $19 for 250, or $39 for 600 rounds — and credits roll over and never expire. Teams and police departments pay $15 per seat a month (300 rounds per seat, 3-seat minimum, manager dashboard). Schools pay $6 per seat (150 rounds, teacher dashboard). Annual plans save about two months: Debater $129, Coach $315, Champion $529 a year.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Cancel in one click and keep access until the end of your billing period. Round-pack credits and any rounds that already rolled over stay in your wallet and never expire; the current month's plan rounds end with the plan.
